rationale: All three lenses ran cleanly. All 12 acceptance criteria pass. Edge-case lens verified DOM order (input before box) and confirmed no global PT collision for RadioButton. One defer finding: RadioButton box ring classes are unconditional while the Checkbox lara preset guards with !props.disabled — not a runtime defect (CSS :focus-visible cannot fire on a disabled input in any browser) but a parity gap worth a follow-up. One dismissed finding: the blind lens suggested ring-offset-* which is explicitly banned by project constraints (white halo in dark mode). Commit subjects match EPMCDME-XXXX: Capital sentence format. No security concerns. 1 deferred finding (disabled-state guard parity), 1 dismissed finding (ring-offset suggestion contradicted by project constraint).
